transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. I'm Dennis. I'm here because... well, I've been having these times where I just eat a lot. And what really made me come in is that once I start eating like that, it feels like I hit some switch. I just keep going, even while part of me is thinking, "Dennis, just stop already." But I can't seem to control it.
After these episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit to try to undo the eating?
No, I don't do that. I've never tried to make myself throw up or anything like that to undo it.
During these episodes, do you eat an unusually large amount of food?

Yeah, I do. Like, on nights after a project deadline, or... or just when the apartment has leftover pizza lying around. I can end up eating a whole small pizza by myself, and then I'll add on chips and a bunch of cereal in my room. It's way more than I ever plan to eat, and definitely a lot more than what my roommates would eat for a normal dinner.
After these eating episodes, do you do anything else to try to make up for the eating, like taking laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot?

No, I don't do any of that either. I don't take laxatives or try to starve myself the next day, and I'm definitely not someone who exercises a lot to burn it off. I just... I just feel really bad about it afterwards, but I don't try to make up for it.
Do these eating episodes cause you a lot of distress?

Yeah, they really do. Afterward I just feel... embarrassed, honestly. And kind of grossed out with myself. It bothers me a lot because I'm usually pretty disciplined when it comes to school and my robotics stuff, so when this happens, it just makes me feel like I'm completely not in control.
During these episodes, do you eat much more quickly than you normally would?

Yeah, I definitely do. During those times I eat really fast. Like, I'll just be standing at my desk between homework and playing a game, and... I barely even taste what I'm eating. I just kind of realize afterward that all the food is gone, and it only took a few minutes.
During these episodes, do you keep eating even after you feel uncomfortably full?

Yeah, I do. I usually only stop when my stomach feels... really tight and heavy. It gets to the point where I'm just uncomfortable sitting at my desk anymore, and I feel like I need to go lie down for a while.
During these episodes, do you eat even when you’re not physically hungry?

Not really, no. I mean, usually when I start eating, I am actually hungry. Like, I'll be working on an assignment and realize my stomach is growling because I haven't eaten in a while. It's just that... I keep going way past the point where that hunger stops. But I don't think I really start eating if I'm not physically hungry in the first place.
During these eating episodes, do you prefer to eat by yourself because you feel embarrassed about how much you’re eating?

Yeah, I do. Like, if my roommates are out in the kitchen, I’ll usually just eat a normal-ish amount while they're around. But then I'll grab extra stuff to take back to my room later. I just... I don’t want them seeing how much I’m actually eating, so I definitely prefer to be by myself when I do it.
How often do these episodes happen?

Well, since early in the semester, it’s been happening most weeks. Usually it's just one night a week, but sometimes two... like if my deadlines are piling up or if there's just a lot of extra food around the apartment. I’d say it's been pretty steady like that for at least the last three or four months.
